title: Afterlife Streamable HTTP MCP Tool Definitions
description: Authoritative JSON Schema catalog for the 14 MCP tools exposed at POST /mcp by afterlifed. Verified against afterlife_daemon::mcp::mcp_tool_definitions() in automated tests.

tools.name: districts_list
tools.description: List the authenticated user's Districts along with their active Philosophy and ProcedureSpec versions.

tools.name: jobs_list
tools.description: List Jobs in the authenticated user's workspace with pagination (optionally filtered by district_id; archived jobs excluded unless include_archived is true).

tools.name: job_get_context
tools.description: Compile the full hierarchical ExecutionContext (District Philosophy + Stage Procedure + Sub-Stage Procedure + GateRubric + recent Feedbacks) for a Job.

tools.name: jobs_create
tools.description: Queue a new Job idempotently into the user's workspace. Inline Markdown links like [LIN-123](https://linear.app/...) in title or raw_input render as clickable links in the UI.

title.description: Job title; supports inline [LABEL](https://...) Markdown links (e.g. Linear ticket IDs).

raw_input.description: Job details/context; supports inline [LABEL](https://...) Markdown links.

tools.name: jobs_update
tools.description: Update a Job's title, raw_input, spec_summary, or target_district_hint. Supports inline [LABEL](https://...) Markdown links. In-district updates require an active fencing_token and cannot target Human ApprovalGates.

title.description: Updated title; supports inline [LABEL](https://...) Markdown links.

raw_input.description: Updated raw input; supports inline [LABEL](https://...) Markdown links.

spec_summary.description: Updated spec summary; supports inline [LABEL](https://...) Markdown links.

tools.name: jobs_archive
tools.description: Soft-delete (archive) a Job out of active views while preserving audit history. Active in-district jobs require fencing_token; Human ApprovalGates cannot be archived by agents.

tools.name: jobs_assign
tools.description: Assign a queued Job into a District's entry stage.

tools.name: jobs_claim
tools.description: Atomically acquire an exclusive lease and monotonic fencing_token on a Job.

tools.name: jobs_heartbeat
tools.description: Extend an active Job lease using the held fencing_token.

tools.name: jobs_advance
tools.description: Advance a Job to its next sub-stage or parent stage as Actor::Agent. Atomically records a StepRecord whose fields satisfy required_step_fields (from context_compile) and any required_artifact_kinds; requires active fencing_token and passing GateVerification on parent-stage exit. Human ApprovalGates cannot be bypassed by agents. Advancing releases the current stage lease so the next step requires a fresh jobs_claim.

tools.name: jobs_rework
tools.description: Send a Job back to the stage's rework target and record the reason as Feedback.

tools.name: artifacts_attach
tools.description: Attach an artifact reference (issue, spec, source_code, pull_request, ci_report, snapshot, verification_report, raw_note) to a leased Job. http(s)://, linear://, and slack:// URIs render as clickable links.

uri.description: Artifact URI; http(s)://, linear://, and slack:// URIs render as clickable links in the UI.

tools.name: gate_verify_record
tools.description: Record an LLM gate verification result against the current stage's GateRubric.

tools.name: feedback_submit
tools.description: Submit structured Feedback on a District/Job/Stage to accumulate learnings for Philosophy and ProcedureSpec evolution.

tools.name: philosophy_propose
tools.description: Propose a new version of a District's explicit Philosophy based on accumulated feedback (requires human sign-off to activate).

tools.name: spec_propose
tools.description: Propose a new version of a District's nested state-machine ProcedureSpec (requires human sign-off to activate).
